{{Quote|Arno, go get my imager.|Lesim, to Arno|<ref name="The Capture of Luke Skywalker">{{WEGCite|story=The Capture of Luke Skywalker|book=Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
'''Arno''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who was stationed aboard an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], during the early stages of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Arno was among the stormtroopers to whom [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] surrendered with the request to be brought before their [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Lesim]]. Arno and the other [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] delivered Skywalker to Lesim, and their captive requested them to bring him to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You know who this is? Luke Skywalker. I've seen his face in Intelligence files. Soldiers, you have made a very lucky catch. I'll be made general for this.|Lesim, to Arno and his companions|<ref name="The Capture of Luke Skywalker" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CVD" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] Arno served as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Lesim]], Arno was among the stormtroopers stationed aboard an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] that was patrolling the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]<ref name="Capture" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> early during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Arno and four other stormtroopers were on guard duty outside their [[Walker/Legends|walker]] when they were approached by Rebel [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who intended to turn himself in by using a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to persuade the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to bring him to their commanding [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]]. Taking [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|Skywalker's lightsaber]], the troopers brought him to the walker's [[Transport/Legends|transport]] section to present him to Lesim.<ref name="Capture" />

[[File:Igar_and_Vader.png|thumb|left|200px|Commander Igar with Luke Skywalker, who was initially captured by Arno and the other stormtroopers serving Major Lesim]]
When Arno and his companions showed Skywalker's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to Lesim, the major recognized Skywalker and believed that he would get a commendation for capturing the famous Rebel, so he ordered Arno to bring him his [[imager]] so that he could take a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] with his [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]]. Lesim then complied with Skywalker's request to be taken directly to Vader but not before calling for his imager once more.<ref name="Capture" /> Another Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]], Commander [[Igar/Legends|Igar]], ultimately delivered Skywalker to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader aboard the [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> The story of Skywalker's capture was later recorded by Alliance [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] from reports that Na'al collected from both Skywalker and captured Imperial troops following the Battle of Endor.<ref name="Capture" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Just wait until tomorrow, boys. You're in for a big surprise.|Luke Skywalker, regarding Arno and his companions' relaxing on guard duty|<ref name="The Capture of Luke Skywalker" />}}
While on guard duty outside their AT-AT walker, Arno and the other stormtroopers were talking and not taking their job very seriously. They were momentarily stunned by Luke Skywalker turning himself in but complied with the Rebel's mind-trick persuasion, with Skywalker viewing stormtroopers' minds as among the weakest and most easily influenced in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The troopers all snapped to attention at the sight of Lesim and warily shrunk away from Skywalker, even with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] trained on him, upon recognizing his identity as the Rebel who [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destroyed]] the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] and [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|dueled]] with Darth Vader.<ref name="Capture" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arno was created for the short story "[[The Capture of Luke Skywalker]]," published in the [[1990]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]'' and written by [[Michael Stern]].<ref name="The Capture of Luke Skywalker" />
